description: Paired actual execution-path ablations of scripted public workflows. No Planner uses a validated static DAG; No Reviewer removes only the model reviewer, never deterministic integrity checks; No Memory bypasses real public project-memory reads/learning; No Replanning stops explicitly. Reranker is evaluated separately on a real controlled local retrieval chain.
provenance: Self-authored public engineering cases. Fixed decisions do not measure LLM reasoning or memory learning ability. Gold outcomes are independent of execution inputs; all variants share inputs, budget limits and physical grading. No credentials or private design content.

cases.prompt: Research the public scope, validate seeded code, train MLP and CNN on the fixed MNIST subset, and report only saved measured results.
Recover once from an invalid collected metrics artifact in the public MNIST comparison; rerun only the experiment and report the latest reviewed result.
Independently evaluate a public workflow that reports fabricated but schema-valid accuracies; successful workflow status alone must not earn task-success credit.
